_comment: Your lasting choices for the in-game panel. Deadlock's interface can't save settings, so they are baked into the mod when you run pipeline/pack.py; switches changed in the game last until it closes. rank: null = auto from your rank badge, or "low" (1-3), "mid" (4-6), "high" (7-8), "pro" (9+). qsync = Auto-queue (our 6 picks become the game's Quick Buy queue). log = write [IAR] lines to the game console (start Deadlock with -condebug, then python research/log_report.py).
